description: History of Arrest(s), Conviction(s) and/or Administrative Action(s). The FAA states: "Arrest(s), conviction(s), and/or administrative action(s) affecting driving privileges may raise questions about the applicant's qualifications for airman medical certification. All incidents must be reported (even if reported on a previous application)", and it adds that this includes "even a single driving while intoxicated" arrest. Note this is not limited to alcohol or drugs: an administrative action affecting your driving privileges counts.
